Imports

davxml

Types

CalReportKind = enum
  rkQuery, rkMultiget
CalReportRequest = object
  kind*: CalReportKind
  hrefs*: seq[string]        ## Raw href values (multiget only).
  wantEtag*: bool
  wantCalData*: bool
  extraProps*: seq[string]   ## Other requested DAV live/dead prop names.
  compName*: string          ## `VEVENT`, `VTODO`, ... or "" for unfiltered.
  timeRange*: CalTimeRange
  hasTimeRange*: bool
CalTimeRange = object
  hasStart*: bool
  hasEnd*: bool
  startUnix*: int64
  endUnix*: int64
Rrule = object
  freq*: string              ## DAILY, WEEKLY, MONTHLY, YEARLY, or "" when unusable.
  interval*: int
  hasCount*: bool
  count*: int
  hasUntil*: bool
  untilUnix*: int64
  byday*: seq[int]           ## WEEKLY weekday set (Mon = 1), empty when absent.

Consts

MaxInstances = 1000
Max recurrence instances expanded per component per REPORT.

Occurrence start times ascending, base instance included. COUNT counts generated candidates (an EXDATEd candidate still consumes count, per RFC 5545 ordering). Generation stops early once candidates reach a bounded rangeEnd, since all supported frequencies are monotonically increasing.
